package oci

import (
 \"bytes\"
 \"context\"
 \"fmt\"
 \"path/filepath\"
 \"testing\"
 \"time\"

 \"github.com/opencontainers/go-digest\"
 v1 \"github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
 \"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config\"
 fliptoci \"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/oci\"
 \"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest\"
 \"oras.land/oras-go/v2\"
 ocistore \"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content/oci\"
)

func TestSourceLocalRefresh(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 dir := t.TempDir()
 repo := filepath.Join(dir, \"flags\")
 publish := func(key string) {
  t.Helper()
  target, err := ocistore.New(repo)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  target.AutoSaveIndex = true
  payload := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(\"namespace: ignored\\nflags:\\n  - key: %s\\n    name: %s\\n    type: BOOLEAN_FLAG_TYPE\\n    enabled: true\\n\", key, key))
  layer := v1.Descriptor{MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptNamespace + \"+yaml\", Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), Annotations: map[string]string{fliptoci.AnnotationFliptNamespace: \"production\"}}
  require.NoError(t, target.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
  manifest, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, target, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, target.Tag(ctx, manifest, \"latest\"))
 }
 publish(\"first\")
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/flags:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(10*time.Millisecond))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = first.GetFlag(ctx, \"production\", \"first\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 same, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Same(t, first, same)
 publish(\"second\")
 second, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NotSame(t, first, second)
 _, err = second.GetFlag(ctx, \"production\", \"second\")
 require.NoError(t, err)

 subctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
 ch := make(chan *storagefs.StoreSnapshot)
 go source.Subscribe(subctx, ch)
 publish(\"third\")
 select {
 case snap := <-ch:
  _, err = snap.GetFlag(ctx, \"production\", \"third\")
  require.NoError(t, err)
 case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal(\"subscription did not publish change\")
 }
 cancel()
 for range ch {}
}
EOF

func TestStore_Fetch_GzipLayer(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 dir := t.TempDir()
 repository := \"compressed\"
 target, err := oci.New(path.Join(dir, repository))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 target.AutoSaveIndex = true
 var compressed bytes.Buffer
 writer := gzip.NewWriter(&compressed)
 _, err = writer.Write([]byte(\"namespace: production\\n\"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, writer.Close())
 payload := compressed.Bytes()
 layer := v1.Descriptor{MediaType: MediaTypeFliptNamespace + \"+yaml+gzip\", Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), Annotations: map[string]string{AnnotationFliptNamespace: \"production\"}}
 require.NoError(t, target.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
 manifest, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, target, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, target.Tag(ctx, manifest, \"latest\"))
 store, err := NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/compressed:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 response, err := store.Fetch(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Len(t, response.Files, 1)
 defer response.Files[0].Close()
 content, err := io.ReadAll(response.Files[0])
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, \"namespace: production\\n\", string(content))
 info, err := response.Files[0].Stat()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, \".yaml\", path.Ext(info.Name()))
}
EOF

Updated `SnapshotSource.Get` and its callers to accept a context. OCI layer handling now supports gzip and namespace annotations.
